title: Are You the A-hole? A Fair, Multi-Perspective Ethical Reasoning Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the aggregated ethical verdicts produced by a reasoning-weighted Z3 MaxSAT solver against Reddit's popularity-based majority vote to measure the disruption of herd dynamics, echo chambers, and majoritarianism.

Using an LLM to evaluate unstructured natural language comments and extract a 'Non-bias' quality score (on a 1 to 5 Likert scale) to mathematically suppress the influence of prejudiced reasoning in the final aggregation.
